{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2011}}
{{main|2011 World Table Tennis Championships}}

[[Wang Hao (table tennis, born 1983)|Wang Hao]] won the title in 2009 and was therefore the defending champion.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24165&Competition_ID=1962&|title=Point Proven and Point to Prove for Top Seeds in Rotterdam|date=2011-05-03|work=ittf.com|access-date=2011-05-03}}</ref> He reached the final where he met fellow Chinese player [[Zhang Jike]].

Zhang won against Hao 12–10, 11–7, 6–11, 9–11, 11–5, 14–12. This was the first time Zhang appeared in the Men's singles event at the [[World Table Tennis Championships|World Championships]] and thus his first medal in this category.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24343&Competition_ID=1962& |title=Zhang Jike in Seventh Heaven, World Title Clinched at First Attempt |date=2011-05-15 |work=ittf.com |access-date=2011-05-19 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110719152155/http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24343&Competition_ID=1962& |archive-date=2011-07-19 }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Based on the ITTF world ranking issued before the Championships, top 64 seeds directly enter first rounds of 128-player sized draw.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |title=2011 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |access-date=5 May 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110322194848/http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |archive-date=22 March 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=1962&Singles=1&Seeded_Singles=1 |title=2011 WTTC Seeds - Men's singles |work=ittf.com |access-date=5 May 2011}}</ref>
